title: Satisfiability certificate characterization
statement: For every finite binary word $x$, the CNF formula decoded from $x$ is satisfiable if and only if there exists a binary word $u$ of length $|x|+1$ such that this decoded formula evaluates to true under the assignment that gives variable $v$ the bit at index $v$ of $u$, and gives false when $v\ge |u|$.
replaced:
For every binary string $x$, the CNF formula decoded from $x$ is satisfiable if and
only if there exists a word $u$ of length exactly $|x| + 1$ such that the decoded
formula evaluates to true under the assignment that reads variable $v$ off the
$v$-th bit of $u$ (default false). [AB09, Theorem~2.10, membership]
